_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Kenji Watanabe
about_me: I'm Kenji, a robotics PhD student in Prof. Anand Iyer's lab at Michigan working on soft grippers for assistive arms. I want a summer 2027 research internship in industry, ideally at an automaker's robotics group. Happy to talk soft robotics with anyone.
goals: Land a summer 2027 industry robotics internship

debriefs.text: Advisor meeting with Prof. Anand Iyer. He consults for Ford's manufacturing robotics group and said he'd mention me to their research lead if I finish the grasping paper by December.

Met Lucia Ferraro at the engineering career fair. She's a recruiter at Ford hiring new-grad embedded engineers for Ford Pro, but she said research interns go through a different pipeline she can point me to.
Talked to Chen Wei after his guest lecture. He's a senior autonomy engineer at GM in Warren and mentors students. He said GM's robotics team takes PhD interns and he'd review my resume.
Sofia Lindqvist from UMSI asked if our gripper could be tested with wheelchair users in her accessibility study. She's recruiting participants now. I said I'd send her our demo video.
Met Tariq Mahmoud at the Kerrytown makerspace. He runs the space and offered after-hours laser cutter access for student projects.

card.headline: Robotics PhD, soft grippers
card.about: Soft grippers for assistive arms in the Iyer lab.
